channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: Category 5 Hurricane Polo is 'one of the strongest storms ever'
item.description: Hurricane Polo has grown into one of the most powerful Pacific cyclones in decades, and it was expected to skirt Mexico's southwestern coast as a Category 5 storm.

item.title: Trump administration to remove 760,000 Affordable Care Act enrollees over fraud claims
item.description: White House officials allege these individuals were fraudulently enrolled in the program or do not exist. Vice President Vance said the move would save $2.2 billion.

item.title: White House launches 'Trump TV' after ban on major news outlets
item.description: Days after President Trump barred reporters from three major news outlets from the White House, the administration has launched a 24/7 YouTube channel promising to put its "biggest moments all in one place."

item.title: Trump's D.C. arch is now a military complex. Here's how that complicates things
item.description: The future of Trump's D.C. arch was already fraught. Then he rebranded it as a military complex. Experts say that only raises more legal and logistical questions.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump. And, Paramount settles in massive merger lawsuit
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico have sued Trump after the networks were suspended from the White House. And, Paramount makes concessions to resolve a lawsuit over its massive Warner Bros. Discovery merger.

item.title: Texas man charged with capital murder after 5-year-old killed in roadway shooting
item.description: Jeremy Porter was charged with capital murder after police said he killed 5-year-old Zah'Layah Walter in a roadway shooting in northwest Harris County.

item.title: Harris keeps 2028 door open as she hits midterm campaign trail, warns ‘28 won’t matter’ without 2026
item.description: Kamala Harris told Detroit voters she has not decided on a 2028 presidential run, stressing that the 2026 midterm elections must come first.

item.title: From Austin to New York, pro-China network fuels week of anti-US protests as Xi meets Trump
item.description: Pro-China groups funded by tech tycoon Neville Roy Singham stage protests from Austin to New York, N.Y., as Trump prepares for Xi Jinping talks.

item.title: El-Sayed mocked for 'word salad' answer when pressed by conservative on voting for him: 'Worse than Kamala's'
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed's town hall remarks referring to pregnant women as "adult or juvenile human" drew fierce backlash in the Michigan Senate race.

item.title: Super Bowl-winning coach reveals 'Cold War' with Broncos' Sean Payton over alleged spying | Matt Calkins
item.description: Mike Macdonald reveals Sean Payton "lost his mind" over Seahawks using fan-filmed Broncos practice plays from social media before their 2024 matchup.

item.title: 'Reacher' star Alan Ritchson claims studios begged him to shut up about politics
item.description: Alan Ritchson claimed studios told him to stop discussing politics and allegedly pulled a White supremacist storyline after President Donald Trump's re-election.

item.title: Missouri mom who put newborn in oven instead of crib learns fate as murder charge dropped
item.description: Mariah Thomas told Kansas City police she mistook the oven for a crib. The infant was found with severe burns across her body in February 2024.

item.title: Bodycam footage captures moments after ICE shooting of Venezuelan migrant in Austin
item.description: Austin Police Department body camera footage captures the moments after an ICE officer shot a Venezuelan migrant during an arrest attempt.

item.title: ICE officer in Texas shooting was recruit not using a body camera
item.description: The officer joined ICE last year during the agency’s hiring spree. DHS is facing mounting scrutiny over how the recruits were vetted and trained.

item.title: Senate Armed Services Committee chair criticizes Trump-Xi meeting
item.description: Republican Sen. Roger Wicker says he disagrees with the “lavish welcome” planned for the Chinese leader, whom he calls an “oppressive dictator.”

item.title: Man convicted of shooting Palestinian students in U.S. after Oct. 7 attack
item.description: Jason Eaton pursued an insanity defense in the 2023 shooting in Vermont, which spread fear through Arab and Muslim communities in the United States.

item.title: Another U.S. service member dies amid Iran war, Pentagon tally shows
item.description: The Defense Department’s disclosed total stands at 19 fatalities, though U.S. officials say the actual number is higher.

item.title: Trump says he’s renaming AI to ‘super intelligence’
item.description: The change, which he said will be reflected on government documents, comes amid growing anxiety about artificial intelligence.

item.title: As lightning claims lives in Florida, experts warn of ‘supercharged’ activity
item.description: Florida leads the nation in lightning deaths as experts see a huge increase in daily strikes this summer.

item.title: Immigrants with final deportation orders disappear from ICE detainee locator
item.description: The change will make it harder for many families and attorneys to determine where an immigrant is being held after being taken into ICE custody.
